critical_code_review_comments: visual_search.py: hardcodes 6MB cap and ALLOWED_MIME inline — fine for now. Falls back to 'Unidentified part' on JSON parse failure rather than 502 — graceful, kept.

job_cards.py: validation is duplicated between Pydantic optionality and manual .strip() empty checks; the strict 400 in create_job_card overrides Pydantic 422. Acceptable but could simplify with Pydantic validators.
job_cards.py PATCH allows status transitions without enforcing a state machine (e.g. completed → open is permitted). Not a blocker for MVP but worth a follow-up.
Both routes use db.workshops.find_one with fallback to member_user_ids — consistent pattern, good.
test_credentials: Workshop Bearer test-token-workshop-1 (gold tier, ws-test-1) — already in /app/memory/test_credentials.md
